Subject: Application for the post of Office Assistant.

Sir/Madam,
With due respect, I would like to apply for the post of Office Assistant advertised by your organization. I have completed my required education and have basic computer, communication and organizational skills. I am sincere, punctual and willing to learn.

I would be grateful if you kindly consider my application and give me an opportunity to attend an interview.
